taskNotes: Bears can be assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness, 65-100), Turael and Spria (10-20), and Mazchna (30-50); no Slayer level is required, only 13 combat.
Black bears, bear cubs, grizzly bears, grizzly bear cubs, reanimated bears, and Callisto count for the task; Angry bears, the Headless Beast, and Crystalline/Corrupted Bears do NOT count.
Krystilia's bears must be killed in the Wilderness (west of the Graveyard of Shadows or near the Dark Warriors' Fortress); starter-master bears are killed anywhere.
Grizzly bear cubs are found only in Isafdar and require partial completion of Regicide to reach.
Bears have a fire spell weakness (grizzly 20%, black bear 30% as of June 2025) but are trivial with any melee weapon.
The slayerTargetId 253 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist §1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
recommendedMethod: Kill any counting bear with any melee weapon - they have negligible Defence and low Hitpoints. Krystilia tasks must be done in the Wilderness (bring only risk-appropriate gear); starter-master tasks are fastest at the Fremennik Province woods or around the Mind Altar.
